card.name: Just before a famous author's surname
card.fires_on: Punctuation or small linking words right before the next name in a list of authors or famous figures, such as a period, comma, space or 'and' after a biography or reading-list entry.

modes.label: Between reading-list entries
modes.description: Period or space ending one author-and-title entry, just before the next author's name.
modes.example: The Claim of Reason and Must We Mean What we Say (various essays). Danto – The Philosophical Disenfranchisment of Art<<. >>Wollheim – Art and its Objects

modes.label: Inside a biography
modes.description: Comma, 'and', 'as' or a title like Mr in a short bio, just before a surname is repeated.

card.writes: It seems to push toward a name or surname coming next and away from study-related words.
card.plain: It fires at the gap just before the next scholar or author name in a bibliography or short biography.
